skill.name: paperclip
skill.description: Coordinate Paperclip work through its control-plane API. Manage assignments, task status, comments, approvals, routines, and artifact uploads.
skill.summary: Coordinate Paperclip tasks and agent work through documented API workflows.
skill.author: getpaperclipai

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are documentation or safely quoted shell syntax rather than executable threats. However, the installation guidance downloads, decodes, and executes remote content with TLS verification disabled; this is a critical supply-chain risk. The troubleshooting command can also terminate an unrelated process on port 3100.

remediation.issue: Installation executes unverified remote content with TLS verification disabled.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the curl pipeline. Distribute a versioned release or checked-in installer and verify a pinned checksum or signature before execution.

remediation.issue: Troubleshooting kills every process listening on port 3100.
remediation.suggestion: Use the managed Paperclip stop command or identify and confirm the owned process before terminating it.

semantic_findings.title: Unverified Remote Code Execution in Installation Instructions
semantic_findings.description: The installation command disables TLS verification, decodes a response from a remote health endpoint, and immediately runs it with Node. A compromised endpoint or network path can execute arbitrary code on the installer machine.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both files contain the complete fetch, decode, write, execute, and cleanup chain, including the -k flag that disables TLS certificate validation.

content.value_statement: Teams need a consistent way to assign work and record progress across agents. This skill uses Paperclip API workflows to coordinate tasks, approvals, comments, routines, and artifacts.
actual_capabilities: Check agent assignments and task context through Paperclip endpoints.
Update task status and add progress comments.
Create subtasks, delegate work, and manage approval follow-up.
Set up and manage recurring Paperclip routines.
Upload a selected workspace file as an issue attachment and artifact.
Use documented Paperclip API request and heartbeat workflows.
limitations: It coordinates Paperclip work but does not perform the assigned domain work.
It requires a running Paperclip instance and valid Paperclip credentials.
It cannot decide business priorities or approve work without authorized workflow context.
The included installation guidance requires security remediation before use.

use_cases.title: Track engineering tasks
use_cases.description: Check assignments, update progress, and leave clear handoff comments.

use_cases.title: Coordinate agent teams
use_cases.description: Delegate subtasks and keep shared task status current across agents.

use_cases.title: Deliver review artifacts
use_cases.description: Attach a selected report, image, or video to an issue for review.

prompt_templates.title: Check my assignments
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my Paperclip inbox and summarize the tasks assigned to me.

prompt_templates.title: Update task progress
prompt_templates.prompt: Update my current Paperclip task to in progress and add a short status comment.

prompt_templates.title: Create a delegated task
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Paperclip subtask for testing the current issue and assign it to the QA agent.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an approval follow-up
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the current Paperclip approval context, list related issues, and prepare the required status updates.

output: Next step: Review issue context and start work.

output_examples.input: Upload the selected test report to the current issue.
output: Artifact uploaded to the current issue.
Work product created with status ready for review.
Parent task comment records the handoff.

best_practices: Confirm the active company, agent, and task before making updates.
Use focused status comments that state progress, blockers, and next steps.
Upload only review-ready files that are appropriate for the current issue.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill to perform unrelated coding or research work.
Do not update tasks that are assigned to another agent without authorization.
Do not upload secrets, private keys, or unrelated workspace files.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It manages Paperclip task coordination, comments, approvals, routines, and artifacts.

faq.question: Can it write application code?
faq.answer: No. Use a domain-specific skill or normal development workflow for the assigned work.

faq.question: What access does it need?
faq.answer: It needs a running Paperclip instance and valid credentials for the authorized company and task.

faq.question: Can it assign work to another agent?
faq.answer: Yes, when the Paperclip workflow and your role authorize delegation.

faq.question: Can it upload files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can upload a selected workspace file as an issue attachment and artifact.

faq.question: Should I use the included installation command?
faq.answer: No. The current remote download-and-execute command needs remediation before it is used.
